events.title: The Dumbegon arrives at Next Fest!
events.summary: The Dumbgeon Demo is featured for Steam Next Fest! Unlock champions, augments, and climb the leaderboards in the latest version of our demo. With this build, you can expect a taste of what is to come at launch on November 30th, 2026. Be sure to wishlist now!

events.title: The Dumbgeon Demo Patch Notes | June 4th
events.summary: PATCH NOTES ADDITIONS• The shop UI was an issue for players. We have a rough version of the new shop UI in the game. It features three windows, and has the player stats in the middle. It is also navigable with the controller. We plan on updating/continuing to work on the Shop.BUG FIXES• Fixed tooltip while using controller• Various controller fixesBALANCE• Adjusted champion stat gains on level upPLANNED• Future update will add 10 new items, a new map and new enemies.—More updates are on the way,

events.title: The Dumbgeon Demo Patch Notes | May 25th
events.summary: PATCH NOTES — The Dumbgeon DemoBUG FIXES• Fixed tooltip in the shop expanding to an incorrect size when hovering over items• Room modifiers now correctly appear on the left side of the screen from wave 4 onward. Good luck• Fixed crafting window displaying and getting stuck on recipes the player doesn't have the components forBALANCE• Adjusted champion stat gains on level up—More updates are on the way, including additional bug fixes and content. Thanks for playing the demo and for all the feedba
